claims: President Trump fired U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi on April 2, 2026.
Pam Bondi was replaced by Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche as Acting Attorney General.
Pam Bondi faced intense criticism from both sides for her handling of the Epstein files.
Pam Bondi failed to release Epstein files documents after suggesting she would.
Pam Bondi's handling of the Epstein files led to accusations of a "cover-up".
Trump was reportedly dissatisfied with the pace of Pam Bondi's actions against his perceived political enemies and critics.
High-ranking officials in the administration had been pushing for Pam Bondi's removal for months.
